pruning.description: Declaration-level pruning: every whole command (declaration with its docstring, attributes and `open ... in` / `omit ... in` style prefix) that the final proofs neither use nor need to compile a kept declaration was deleted, then the modules left without needed content were dropped and their imports rewritten to the frontier. Kept declarations are byte-identical to the port; entries and fix records of dropped modules were removed; fix line numbers refer to the pruned files.
pruning.kept_modules: every module of the port except the dropped_modules of the pruning record

fixes.description: added `public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.IntervalIntegral.ContDiff`; `enorm_sub_le_lintegral_deriv_of_contDiffOn_Icc` was only reachable through a non-public Mathlib import chain.
same `contDiff_apply` codomain-family change as in PolynomialSmooth, at two sites (lines 94 and 99).

`private noncomputable def physicalResidueCoordinateEquiv` is used in the body of the exposed public def `ofPhysicalResidueEquiv`; a private declaration cannot appear in an exposed body, so `private` was removed (as in the earlier port of this library).
`simp [writtenInExtChartAt, coordinateLine]` now closes the goal by itself, so the trailing `rfl` failed with "no goals"; the `rfl` line was deleted.
added `public import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Haar.InnerProductSpace`: `OrthonormalBasis.volume_parallelepiped` is only reachable through a non-public Mathlib import chain.
added `public import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Star.Real`: the instance `StarOrderedRing ℝ` was not reachable through the Mathlib imports.

`map_add`/`map_sub` on `LinearEquiv`s of `F.RealFirstCoefficientModule w` (lines 320, 394, 409, 423 of the converted file) hit the synthInstance heartbeat limit: for `AddMonoidHomClass (X ≃ₗ[ℝ] Y) X Y` Lean tries `SemilinearMapClass.instAddMonoidHomClass` and the other generic instances first and searches `Module ?R X`. One added line `attribute [local instance 1100] AddEquivClass.instAddMonoidHomClass` (file-local) makes the cheap `AddEquivClass` route first; the upstream body is unchanged.

`map_add`/`map_sub`/`map_zero` on `LinearEquiv`s over quotient modules (the `rw [map_sub]` sites, lines 92 and 689 of the vendored file after pruning) hit the synthInstance heartbeat limit: for `AddMonoidHomClass (X ≃ₗ[ℝ] Y) X Y` Lean tries `SemilinearMapClass.instAddMonoidHomClass` and other generic instances first and searches `Module ?R X`. One added line `attribute [local instance 1100] AddEquivClass.instAddMonoidHomClass` (file-local) makes the cheap `AddEquivClass` route first; the upstream body is unchanged (same fix as ReducedRelativeCoefficientBounds).

the `(by simp)` proof in the `variable (b : Basis κ ℝ (… realFirstCoefficientFastSubmodule (fun _ => 1) (by simp) …))` binder is elaborated at the `variable` command into a private auxiliary theorem `_private.…FastCoefficientDerivativeCoordinates.0._proof_32`, which is not exported by the module, so the kernel of every importer that uses the theorems of this file failed with "unknown constant" (UnnormalizedCommonSymbolFactorization); replaced by the term proof `(fun _ => Nat.zero_lt_one)` (the one other files already use for this argument).
